title: Super cute great price
text:
Super cute great price. Thanks for such a cute little box for my Christmas goodie baskets🎄
Every year we give out treats for Christmas it's so hard to find containers that don't break the bank 🎅
these are perfect if you don't need a huge container
I use cupcake wrappers in assorted sizes to place my different goodies in and then arranged them in side it held a nice selection of treats
I included a photo and used a coffee cup to give a size comparison

product_metadata.title: SANTA'S WORKSHOP TREAT BOXES - Party Supplies - 12 Pieces
description: "Homemade cookies fudge and other holiday treats are always a welcome gift especially when they're given in these adorable treat boxes. Each treat box resembles Santa's workshop and offers plenty of room for baked goodies. Cardboard. 6 1/2 Simple assembly required. OTC"
